text: AuthService authenticates incoming requests and depends on PostgresCluster for user credentials.
PaymentGateway uses AuthService to validate customer sessions before processing transactions.
PaymentGateway stores transaction records in PostgresCluster and uses RedisCache for temporary transaction state.
Incident-304 caused PaymentGateway failures after RedisCache became unavailable.
IAM-Failover-Policy governs AuthService permissions during regional authentication failures.
MonitoringService monitors PaymentGateway and generates alerts when transaction latency exceeds the configured threshold.
NotificationService depends on AuthService to validate notification delivery permissions.
Incident-305 affected NotificationService because PaymentGateway generated invalid event payloads.
PlatformEngineering operates MonitoringService and maintains its production deployment.
DatabaseOperations manages PostgresCluster and handles database failover procedures.
Incident-306 affected AuthService after PostgresCluster experienced connection exhaustion.
AuthService depends on RedisCache to retrieve cached session information.
IAM-Failover-Policy governs PaymentGateway access permissions during disaster recovery.
MonitoringService monitors PostgresCluster and RedisCache to identify infrastructure availability problems.
Incident-307 affected PaymentGateway and AuthService after PostgresCluster became unavailable.
